themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers research conducted or assisted by autonomous AI agents, focusing on their capabilities, limitations, and application in discovery and analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, including their security implications and performance benchmarks.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing various AI-powered tools and platforms specifically designed to aid researchers in data collection, analysis, and discovery.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated users or data for research, testing, and simulation purposes, including their limitations and trustworthiness.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is integrated into the design process for UX, UI, and product design, as well as its application in broader research methodologies.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to extract actionable insights from customer data, feedback, and interactions to inform product development and strategy.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools and techniques for condensing large amounts of text, such as research papers, earnings calls, or transcripts, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to automate various testing processes in software development, from functional testing to security checks.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in evaluating the usability and user experience of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI in qualitative research methods, including analysis of interviews, thematic extraction, and understanding nuanced human perspectives.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
